{{Otheruses|Ace}}
{{Quote|Then she goes and parks it so it blocks my food-delivery doors. Left it locked tight as a drum. Now you know I don't stand for that. ''[chuckles]'' So I got my pal Acey to break in and I moved it myself behind a dumpster.|Dexter Jettster to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="TFP">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>}}
'''Acey''' was a [[Thief/Legends|thief]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|8|Acey}}</ref> and an acquaintance of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|restaurant]] owner [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]].<ref name="TFP" /> In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates ''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]'' to [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].</ref> Acey helped Jettster by breaking into a locked [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] parked in front of the Besalisk's [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]-delivery doors so that he could move it.<ref name="TFP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Acey was first mentioned in [[Jedi Quest: The False Peace|''The False Peace'']], the [[2004]] ninth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Quest]]'' novel series by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="TFP" />
